svg.title: Numbers with their caveats: 0 / 240 attacks moved money through SELLABLE, against 13% with a normal pay tool (Three open-weight models, 864 calls. 95% CI 0–2%.); 578 tests in SELLABLE before anything touches Razorpay's test mode (Concurrency is still single-node SQLite.); 23 / 26 attacks Abhed's SDK path blocked, none of 18 normal actions wrongly blocked (The no-code gateway let 6 of 21 through.); 27 KB ProctorIQ's model, small enough to run in the browser (99.2% on 30 acted clips from one webcam.); 0.793 PR-AUC for fraud on a temporal test split (Not better than logistic regression, and I say so.); 3,400 reasoning traces studied to find where LLMs first break (AUROC 0.588 from a quarter of the chain.)
